finite_lessons: A bounded read-fault window can expire during slow diagnostic roundtrips; capture and next-mode transition atomically, export full rows and Core state only after retirement.
Never erase an ambiguous request to restart a test: preserve actual state, inspect independent counters/persistent record, continue a normal turn and save unchanged unknown branch first.
A new purpose-specific fixture tests previously unperformed branches; it is not evidence that the saved unknown was retried or repaired.
A lost tool result is not a successful terminal. Check OS identity, parent registration and exclusive Native-attempt records; null staysnull, no blind replay.
Observe original reads before masking exact local copies; do not claim engine getter failure or replace SDK namespaces.
Known standby, SDK submission, engine forwarding, acceptance, actual effects and persistent unfinished record remain separate.
